answer: Work waits on the reef until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
